confidence_notes: Delhi price indexes support the meal, coffee, and beer estimates. Cocktail data is sparse, so it is estimated at roughly three times local draft beer; wine by the glass is estimated at roughly 1.8 times beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate with substantial property and location variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Delhi-specific price data informs food and drink; no city proxy was used. Accommodation uses broad South Asian capital-city lodging norms.
